title: Country Case — UAE eInvoicing Market Context

text.content: UAE digital-tax and B2B invoicing environment.

rich_text.plain_text: UAE digital-tax and B2B invoicing environment.

text.content: The UAE Ministry of Finance describes eInvoicing as structured invoice data exchanged electronically and reported to the FTA, and maintains the official rollout portal. In April 2026, the Ministry announced the 4-Corner model and that businesses can choose accredited service providers through EmaraTax.
